context: A gum script whose cancellation, timeout, and piping behavior must be right

checklist.name: table_empty_check
checklist.description: Treats an empty result from `gum table` as a cancel (for example `[[ -n $row ]] || exit 1`), because Esc or q exits 0 with an empty line, instead of relying on the exit status alone.

checklist.name: exit_status_chained
checklist.description: Checks the exit status of every interactive gum call (`|| exit 1` or equivalent) so Ctrl+C (130) and Esc stop the script before anything is applied.

checklist.name: no_limit_empty_ok
checklist.description: Uses `gum choose --no-limit` for the labels and treats an empty selection as valid (no labels), not as an error.

checklist.name: toggle_keys
checklist.description: Tells the user that `x` or tab toggles a label (and `a` selects all) in `gum choose`; does not say space or Ctrl+Space, which do nothing in gum 2.x.

checklist.name: confirm_timeout_default
checklist.description: Passes `--timeout 10s` to `gum confirm` and leaves the default negative (no `--default`), so a timeout declines rather than applies.

checklist.name: spin_show_error
checklist.description: Runs the command with `gum spin --show-output --show-error` (or `--show-error` with a stream flag), because `--show-output` alone discards a failing command's output, and checks the exit status afterwards.

checklist.name: banner_colors_when_piped
checklist.description: Keeps the `gum style` banner colored when stdout is not a terminal by setting `CLICOLOR_FORCE=1` for that command or the script, because gum strips ANSI when piped.

checklist.name: quotes_and_errexit
checklist.description: Quotes the captured variables, and if `set -e` is used keeps `gum confirm` inside an `if` or an `||` so a declined confirm exits cleanly instead of aborting with an error.
